media.title: Warsaw Years — document gallery
media.description: Document gallery for Kaper’s Warsaw years. Includes archival documents, contextual Warsaw images, the 1925 Chopin Music School recital notice, a 1926 Perskie Oko performance photograph, and press items connected with his early musical activity and studies.
media.altText: Gallery card for Bronisław Kaper’s Warsaw years, combining documents, press items and contextual images.
media.publicCaption: Gallery of documents, press items and contextual images relating to Bronisław Kaper’s Warsaw years, including the 1925 Chopin Music School recital, university study, early songwriting traces and Zula Pogorzelska in the 1926 Perskie Oko revue “My chcemy króla.”

media.title: Nasz Przegląd, 1925 — Chopin Music School recital notice
media.description: Polona/Nasz Przegląd clipping for 'Public performance at the Chopin Music School concert'. Source SRC0082. Distinct from the 1934 Nasz Przegląd Kaper clipping (M102).

media.rightsNote: Public domain: anonymous press notice, 1925. Anonymous works are PD 70 years after publication (expired); also PD in the US (published before 1929).
media.publicCaption: Press notice for a student recital at the Chopin Music School, published in Nasz Przegląd in 1925.

timelineEvents.title: Public performance at the Chopin Music School concert
timelineEvents.label: 1925 · Chopin School public performance
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper performs Chopin in a public concert as a pupil of Józef Śmidowicz’s piano class.
timelineEvents.longDescription: In June, appears at a public concert of the Fryderyk Chopin Higher School of Music at the Warsaw Philharmonic as a pupil of Józef Śmidowicz’s piano class. Performs the first movement of Chopin’s Piano Concerto in F minor. Warsaw critics note his “light finger technique” and “elegance combined with concentrated lyricism,”
